claims.statement: Tom Allen said he had fought nineteen battles in the ring and had fought for more money than any man living.
claims.excerpt: I have fought nineteen battles in the ring, and I have fought for more money than any man living

claims.statement: Tom Allen said he stood unrivaled as champion of the middle weights of England.
claims.excerpt: I stand unrivaled as champion of the middle weights

claims.statement: Tom Allen fought Posh Price in England, the bout lasting two hours and five minutes.
claims.excerpt: My last five fights in England were with Posh Price and George Iles, the former lasting two hours and five minutes and the latter two hours.

claims.statement: Tom Allen fought George Iles in England, the bout lasting two hours.
claims.excerpt: My last five fights in England were with Posh Price and George Iles, the former lasting two hours and five minutes and the latter two hours.

claims.statement: Tom Allen fought Bob Smith in England, the bout lasting three hours.
claims.excerpt: And my fight with Bob Smith (the black) lasted three hours

claims.statement: Tom Allen's last fight with Joe Goss in England lasted one hour and fifty-seven minutes until darkness and was agreed as a draw.
claims.excerpt: my last fight with Joe Goss was one hour and fifty-seven minutes, when darkness came on; the next morning the doctors advised us to agree to a draw which we did

claims.statement: Tom Allen beat Charlie Gallagher in under twenty minutes, by his own account.
claims.excerpt: Now these men did not last above twenty minutes when they met me

claims.statement: Tom Allen beat Bill Davis in under twenty minutes, by his own account.
claims.excerpt: Now these men did not last above twenty minutes when they met me

claims.statement: Tom Allen beat Mike McCoole in under twenty minutes, by his own account.
claims.excerpt: Now these men did not last above twenty minutes when they met me

claims.statement: Tom Allen sparred with Rocky Moore, the first man he sparred with in America, and made a child of him with the gloves.
claims.excerpt: he was the first man I sparred with in the country, and I made a child of him with the gloves

claims.statement: Tom Allen's sparring with Rocky Moore was stopped when the crowd came on the stage to mob him.
claims.excerpt: because I hit him so hard and so often they came on the stage and attempted to mob me, and they stopped the sparring

quotes.speaker: Tom Allen
quotes.text: I have fought some of the longest battles of any man in the world, as my record will show.
quotes.topic: answering the Republican on long fights

quotes.speaker: Tom Allen
quotes.text: I have fought nineteen battles in the ring, and I have fought for more money than any man living.

quotes.speaker: Tom Allen
quotes.text: for he is too big a coward to whip any man.

fights.excerpt: My last five fights in England were with Posh Price and George Iles, the former lasting two hours and five minutes and the latter two hours.
fights.notes: Allen's own list of his last five English fights; winner not stated.

And my fight with Bob Smith (the black) lasted three hours

fights.notes: Stopped by darkness; draw agreed. Article 521 gives a different duration (1 hour 52 minutes); not reconciled here.

fights.excerpt: Now these men did not last above twenty minutes when they met me
fights.notes: Win implied, not stated outright. 'These men' follows the Gallagher-Davis, Gallagher-Elliott and McCoole-Coburn sentences; Elliott and Coburn are not named as Allen's opponents here.

fights.excerpt: Now these men did not last above twenty minutes when they met me
fights.notes: Win implied, not stated outright (see Gallagher entry).

notes: Card from Allen replying to the Republican. Fight list is his own account. Hints named Gallagher, Davis and McCoole for the 'twenty minutes' line; the text supports those three but does not say each was a bout with Allen.
